# E-Bike PSI

> Professional e-bike tire pressure calculator with precise PSI recommendations for 150+ models from 45 brands. Weight-based calculations with terrain adjustments for fat tire, cargo, folding, commuter, and moto-style e-bikes.

## About

E-Bike PSI is a free, professional-grade tire pressure calculator designed specifically for electric bikes. Unlike generic tire pressure guides, our calculator accounts for e-bike-specific factors: heavier bike weights, motor placement, cargo capacity, and the unique tire configurations found on modern e-bikes.

The tool covers 152 verified e-bike models across 45 brands, providing personalized front and rear tire pressure recommendations based on rider weight, cargo load, and terrain type.

## Calculator

- URL: https://ebikepsi.com/calculate
- Description: Interactive PSI calculator with model presets or custom tire dimensions
- Input: Bike model or tire size, rider weight, cargo weight, terrain type, tire construction
- Output: Front and rear PSI recommendations (min/target/max) with safety warnings

## Key Facts

- 152 verified e-bike models from 45 brands
- Weight-based PSI calculations (front and rear independently)
- Terrain adjustments: pavement, mixed, dirt, sand/snow
- Tire construction support: tubed, tubeless, reinforced
- Trike (3-wheel) mode with independent rear calculations
- Safety alerts: pinch flat risk, blowout warnings, rim protection
- UK/EU edition with Bar + PSI units
- Free to use, no signup required
- PWA support (installable, works offline)
